name: random-team-reviewer
description: GitHub Action: random reviewer from a team

scripts.act: act pull_request -j random-reviewer -W act/act-test.yml -e act/pull_request.json --secret-file act/.secrets --env ACT_LOCAL=true -P ubuntu-latest=catthehacker/ubuntu:act-22.04
scripts.act:arm64: act pull_request -j random-reviewer -W act/act-test.yml -e act/pull_request.json --secret-file act/.secrets --env ACT_LOCAL=true -P ubuntu-latest=catthehacker/ubuntu:act-22.04 --container-architecture linux/amd64
